description.en: Taken from the printed row: This is a grid-powered building pour through a pipeline. Keep this cell as published. Read the 24 mm stone cell: 60 m horizontal / 180 m vertical. Read it in the Xingtai table. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. This page names no project, no country job, no price and no daily volume.
